thesis: A sharp completed-bar pullback inside a positive intraday trend can earn a cost-resilient long-only rebound when entered after the opening period and held for roughly two hours.
rationale: A causal coarse screen found the economically motivated EMA-positive, one-bar drop, low range-position family positive after a conservative six-basis-point round trip in each chronological segment. The formal event engine now tests a bounded neighborhood with production costs, stops, targets, position limits, and immutable gates.
